            for r in range(4):
                for c in range(4):
                    val = grid[r_start + r][c_start + c]
                    if val not in [0, 5]:
                        colors.add(val)

            if not colors:

            color = list(colors)[0]
            
            # Detect which pattern we have
            # Count cells in each row of the subgrid
            row_counts = [sum(1 for (r, c) in pattern_cells if r == rc) for rc in range(4)]
